description: Values or formulas into an A1 range that names its sheet ("Invoices!A2:C4"), parsed as if typed (USER_ENTERED): "=SUM(B2:B9)" is a formula, "28/09/2026" a date in the sheet's locale. Returns `before`, what those cells held (formulas as formulas), so the write can be undone by writing it back.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

range.description: A1 range with its sheet, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D20".

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet's id, or its URL.

values.description: Rows of cells, top to bottom.

name: write_range
title: Write a range
